evidence: Changes libbitcoinkernel C API headers and implementation in `src/kernel/`, dropping `logging.cpp` from the kernel library build and updating `src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp`.
rationale: Substantially improves the libbitcoinkernel boundary by replacing brittle string parsing with structured `btck_LogEntry` callbacks and removing the node logging subsystem (`logging.cpp`) from the kernel build. Decoupling node dependencies from the kernel library directly serves core kernel objectives and unblocks downstream work in #30342 and #33847.
